# mtlm-router

> A self-hosted, CPU-friendly typed decision appliance. A frozen ~7M-param
> pure-Machin/MFL trunk converts natural-language requests into machine-readable
> routing decisions with confidence, abstention, and delegation — specialist
> `.head` lanes add domain classification without retraining the trunk.
> Jev/System One-compatible interfaces. No GPU, no external calls.

## Product

- [Landing](index.html): what it is, measured benchmarks, download links
- [Docs](docs.html): endpoints, decision fields, conformal gating, systemone,
  MCP adapter, quickstart
- [Lane catalog](catalog.html): free certified lane packs installable via
  `tools/lane_install.py` (clinc150, banking77, civic, civic_fr, helpdesk, eq_tone)
- [Pricing](pricing.html): free Apache-2.0 catalog, custom lane packs,
  commercial licensing, hosted API

## Hosted API (pay-per-decision, peage rail)

- Base: https://api.mtlm-router.intrane.fr — agent docs at
  https://api.mtlm-router.intrane.fr/llms.txt (wallet flow, pricing, errors)
- Free metadata: GET /v1/lanes (10 installed lanes), GET /pricing,
  GET /.well-known/api-catalog (RFC 9727 linkset)
- Free demo: POST /demo/route {"state","text","expert"?} — rate-limited,
  CORS-locked to the landing
- Metered: POST /v1/route with X-Peage-Wallet — 1 cent = 20 decisions
- Docs section: docs.html#hosted-api

## Machine-readable

- Full corpus: https://mtlm-router.intrane.fr/llms-full.txt (README + lanes + pricing + hosted API doc in one fetch)
- Agent card: https://mtlm-router.intrane.fr/.well-known/agent.json (A2A-style skills + capabilities)
- MCP server card: https://mtlm-router.intrane.fr/.well-known/mcp/server.json (MCP registry manifest)
- OpenAPI spec: https://github.com/javimosch/mtlm-router/blob/master/openapi.yaml
- Repository: https://github.com/javimosch/mtlm-router
- Lane registry (index.json): https://github.com/javimosch/mtlm-heads
- Changelog: https://github.com/javimosch/mtlm-router/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md
- Latest release: https://github.com/javimosch/mtlm-router/releases/latest

## Measured numbers (rbm21 CPU, harnesses in repo)

- Route API: p50 60–150ms (idle scratch → loaded production box,
  `bench/route_latency.py`)
- Decode: ~470 tok/s p50 on the 7M int8 trunk (`bench/gen_speed.py`)
- 5 lanes installed: +1.4MB RSS, ~0 added latency (`bench/` scaling run)
- Abstention: banking77 84.4% ID-OOS recall, clinc150 abstains 20.4%
  (certified lanes, metrics in pack manifests)
- Decision contract: `set_size`/`qhat` (conformal), `candidates[]`
  (clarification shortlist on abstain), `margin` (top1−top2 gap) — see
  openapi.yaml RouteDecision
- Release verification: `tools/verify_appliance.py` checks every manifest
  sha256 on a tarball or extracted tree; releases ship `*.tar.gz.sha256`
